rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable description of a good-quality blastocyst, but it likely overcalls the stage as full/early-hatching and describes ICM/TE detail with more confidence than the single image supports.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, BMI, endometrium, semen parameters, prior cycle history, and embryo quality into prognosis and management.

Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimates and recommendations generally following from the data; minor issue is some overinterpretation of morphology relative to the reported 3AB grade.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based assessment, including caution about hydrosalpinx and limited role for routine PGT-A at age 24; slight deviation is the tendency to reclassify the embryo stage from the image alone.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, hydrosalpinx evaluation, luteal support adherence, and future cycle review/optimization with appropriate nuance.
